Subject: Briefing: Redwood inference demo — timing & procurement sync

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute demo focused on latency/cost tradeoffs and a short procurement sync so your FinanceOps team can understand the billing model before the legal/PO work starts. Two scheduling constraints you mentioned: the CFO-led spend freeze window around your quarter close and Tom's travel the second week of December.

Quick asks from our side to make the session high-impact:
- Can you confirm the earliest date your procurement team can review a PO?
- Will the CFO be available for a 10-minute exec summary, or should we send a pre-recorded 5-min executive brief instead?
- Any list of technical/IT/security contacts to include for SOC 2 evidence requests?

Attached: one-pager we discussed (stub: AcmeCo_MATP_budget_summary.xlsx)

If it helps, we can tentatively hold two slots: Dec 8 (pre-travel) and Dec 22 (post-reset). If you prefer, we can do a short recorded walkthrough for execs while the team is traveling.

Thanks —
Mateo

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the follow-up. Quick status: our Q4 close is the week of Dec 13–17 and Finance has instituted a temporary spend freeze through the close. CFO will be in strategy offsite between Dec 14–16 and Tom will be traveling Dec 14–18. Given that, our earliest practical date for an actionable procurement review is the week of Dec 20 (Dec 20–23).

We'd love the product walkthrough sooner for the product team — a technical session on Dec 8 could work for engineers (they're available), but any purchase conversation will have to wait until after the freeze. If you can provide a short executive brief (5–7 minutes) we can share it with the CFO ahead of the week of Dec 20.

I'll loop in FinanceOps separately for PO template and vendor setup. Attaching a quick snapshot of the projected spend band for this initiative (stubbed).

Best,
Alice

Team —

FYI from Acme: spend freeze through Dec 17, travel Dec 14–18; procurement review earliest week of Dec 20. Two things I want to move on:

1) Offer a short pre-recorded 5-min exec brief and a 30-min technical walkthrough the week of Dec 8 for the engineering/IT stakeholders (keeps momentum).
2) Plan a live demo + procurement Q&A for Dec 21 or Dec 22 aimed at FinanceOps + CFO if available. We should prepare a PO template and quick onboarding checklist (Monica, can you own the onboarding checklist and a 30-day success plan?)

Other options: if Acme insists on an earlier PO, we can propose a conditional kickoff (letter of intent + 30-day evaluation) but that requires Exception approval from our finance team. Rishi — do we want to offer a short 90-day pilot pricing guardrail or stick to standard terms?

Attachments to prep: AcmeCo_PO_template.pdf (PO stub), exec_brief.mp4 (recording placeholder)

Thanks —
Mateo

Agree with Matt's plan (typo: Mateo). Quick notes:

- Monica, please build a 30/60/90 onboarding checklist that includes: vendor setup steps, key contacts for SOC 2 evidence, trial throughput targets, and a checklist for reserved capacity if they opt for Dedicated. Keep it tight — one page.
- Rishi, on pilot economics: offer a capped pilot estimate for the 90-day POC (flat fee + token-based overage) — we can escalate a 10% onboarding credit if procurement pushes for it to close before year-end.
- Mateo, I can own the exec summary email to the CFO and coordinate a 10-minute slot during the week of Dec 20. If the CFO prefers on-demand, we will send the recorded brief.

Let's hold tentative calendar blocks: Dec 8 (tech walkthrough), Dec 21 10:00–11:00 PST (procurement + exec Q&A). I'll draft MOA text and share.

Laura
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
